name: Furutachi Ren
source:
She loves cute things, shiny things--basically anything she can squeal over.

When she meets [url=/c87518]Akuru[/url] it's love at first sight--this woman is totally her type! In an attempt to win her heart, she ends up pushing her way into Akuru's home.

[spoiler]Her real name is Love, writen with the same Kanji as 'Ren' (恋).[/spoiler]
